reviewer: evidence_pipeline independent reviewer after own authoring completed
scope: All nonretail keys: geo, sectors, earnings_pattern, underowned, crypto, flows, anticipatory, catalysts. Retail excluded and unchanged.
methods: Read nonretail prose alongside each paragraph's exact own-date cited headlines.
Checked source membership/category windows and completed-versus-preview status, then examined high-risk release/event timing.
Matched numerical prices, returns, yield/spread units and session tags to frozen own-date card; spot-FX amendment enforced.
Checked issuer/business identity, source-topic fit and cross-section consistency; preserved retail exactly.
headline_only_limit: No full publisher article body or original-vintage verification; structural source acquisition separately reviewed.

findings.issue: Disney parks-profit headline was used to motivate a digital-distribution/platform thesis.
findings.action: Reframed the item around existing parks assets and return on expansion; removed unsupported digital-platform role.

findings.issue: Tesla autonomy-rule headline was followed by unrelated interest-rate/inflation scenario.
findings.action: Aligned all three parts with the actual pending self-driving policy process and its commercial risks.

findings.issue: A stale Nov18 Nvidia-preview headline sat in an anticipatory item despite the result already being available at this cutoff.
findings.action: Replaced the stale preview scenario with the genuinely pending Huawei early2025 production plan; acknowledged known Nvidia result and after-bell reaction.

findings.issue: Ron Baron valuation-view headline did not support the stated self-driving policy catalyst.
findings.action: Replaced it with the own-date Reuters planned-rule headline; retained conditional policy-versus-delivery framing.

findings.issue: Aggregator headline's raises wording could imply financing settlement was complete.
findings.action: Narrowed the description to reported financing terms and avoided a settlement assertion.

findings.issue: Joined words and commodity currency without physical unit reduced readability.
findings.action: Separated joined tokens and added per-barrel/per-pound units to existing quoted futures prices.

validation: Own-date verifier passed with zero failures and zero warnings after narrow edits.
treasury_validation: Manually matched own-card 2Y/10Y prior-close levels, 10Y-2Y bps spread, quoted five/twenty-observation bps changes and curve labels.
spot_fx_exclusion: No numeric spot-FX pair levels/returns in reviewed nonretail prose; DXY index retained.
